statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp 5) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 50

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7034 · 将原型全域因子上界降至五十
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7034 · Reduce the full prototype factor bound to fifty

brief.zh: 对 n≥2313 用模 510510 的 19 粗候选与 exp 5<51 log 19；更小的偶数取 p=2，因 n−2<2^51。
brief.en: For n≥2313 use the 19-rough candidate modulo 510510 and exp 5<51 log 19. For smaller even n take p=2, since n−2<2^51.
